create.name: Cassandra Vieten
create.bio:
Cassandra Vieten is a clinical psychologist and researcher who studies spirituality, transformative experiences, mindfulness and the science of imagination. She earned her PhD in clinical psychology at the California Institute of Integral Studies and trained in behavioural genetics research at the University of California, San Francisco. She spent many years at the Institute of Noetic Sciences, serving as its President from 2013 to 2019 and remaining a Senior Fellow, and later led the John W. Brick Mental Health Foundation. She is a Clinical Professor at UC San Diego, where she directs the Center for Mindfulness.

Her teaching joins research findings with practice. In workshops at places such as Esalen, in talks and in online courses, she looks at how people change, how imagination shapes what we think, feel and do, and how meditation and contemplative practice can be brought into daily life. Her books include Imagine That, on the science of imagination; Living Deeply, a study of transformation across traditions written with Marilyn Schlitz and Tina Amorok; and Spiritual and Religious Competencies in Clinical Practice, guidelines for therapists written with Shelley Scammell. She also teaches on The Shift Network.

books.title: Imagine That: Transform How You Think, Feel, and Live with the Science of Imagination
books.author: Cassandra Vieten
books.description: Draws on research to argue that imagination is a basic process behind how we think, feel and act, not just a creative extra. Offers ways to understand your own imagination and use it more deliberately in daily life. Foreword by Pete Docter.

books.title: Living Deeply: The Art & Science of Transformation in Everyday Life
books.author: Marilyn Schlitz, Cassandra Vieten, Tina Amorok
books.description: Based on a decade of research by the Institute of Noetic Sciences, including interviews with teachers from many traditions, it looks at what lasting inner change has in common across paths. Each chapter ends with practical exercises.

books.title: Spiritual and Religious Competencies in Clinical Practice: Guidelines for Psychotherapists and Mental Health Professionals
books.author: Cassandra Vieten, Shelley Scammell
books.description: Sets out sixteen research-based competencies to help therapists work respectfully with their clients' spiritual and religious beliefs and practices. Written for psychotherapists and counsellors, with a foreword by Daniel J. Siegel.

books.title: Welcoming All That We Are: 52 Activities for Women's Groups
books.author: Billie Rogers, Cassandra Vieten
books.description: A year of group activities arranged by season, for women's circles that want to explore their strengths and support one another. Each activity comes with simple instructions for the person leading it.

courses.title: Imagine That: Transform How You Think, Feel, and Live with the Science of Imagination (Esalen)
courses.description: A weekend residential workshop at Esalen Institute, Big Sur, on the science and everyday use of imagination. Participants build their own imagination profile through presentations, experiential practices and thought experiments. Guest faculty: Fabrice Guerrier.
courses.price: From $940 USD (sleeping bag space; shared and private rooms $1,276–$3,896 USD per guest)
